transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. I came in because... well, I've been having trouble keeping my thoughts straight when I talk. 

I'm a jeweler, and lately, when people ask me a really simple question—like when a ring repair will be ready—my answer just goes all over the place. I'll start talking about the invoices, and then somehow I'm on to garden soil, and then mortgage papers... and I can just see them losing me. It's just getting really hard to communicate clearly, and I wanted to see what's going on.
Do your thoughts feel unusually fast or as though they are racing?
No, not really. I wouldn't say they're racing. It's not like my brain is going a mile a minute or anything... it's just that the connections get all mixed up. So, no, they don't feel unusually fast.
When did you first notice this difficulty keeping your thoughts straight when you speak?
Let me think... this whole change has been going on since, well, not long after we took on the business mortgage. So I'd say it's been almost two years now.
Have you been having trouble remembering recent conversations or events?

No, I haven't really noticed any issues with my memory. I can remember conversations and what's happened recently just fine. It's really just the getting my words out in a straight line that's the problem.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not hear or see?

Well, yes, I suppose I have. Sometimes when the shop is quiet, I'll hear a woman muttering my name... it sounds like it's coming from the polishing room. And other times, I'll smell burning metal when I know for a fact all the torches are turned off. It feels real enough that I always get up and go check, but there's never anything there.
Since these changes began, have you noticed a significant decline in your ability to do your work as a jeweler?

Yes, it's definitely affected my work. I've actually had to cut back on taking custom orders. I keep missing deadlines for repairs, and... well, when I'm doing client consultations, I just lose track of what we're talking about. I even need my husband to double-check the invoices now, which is something I always used to handle myself without any problem.

{"intent":"Determine whether the hallucinations and disorganized thinking represent a longstanding psychotic disorder or a new-onset condition","question":"Before these past two years, had you ever experienced hearing or seeing things that other people did not, or had similarly disorganized speech?	"}

No, never. Before all this started a couple of years ago, I never had any of those issues. I never heard voices or smelled things that weren't there, and I certainly didn't have trouble keeping my thoughts straight or speaking clearly. It's all just started happening recently.
Have you had difficulty managing your finances or paying bills, tasks you previously handled without problems?

No, I wouldn't say I've had difficulty with that. Like I mentioned, I have my husband look over the business invoices just to be safe, but as far as paying our regular bills or managing the finances at home, I haven't had any problems doing that. I still handle all of that just fine.
Have you been diagnosed with a new neurological or other medical illness since these symptoms began?

No, I haven't. I haven't been diagnosed with any new medical conditions or neurological issues since all this started. I've just been dealing with these changes, but no new diagnoses from a regular doctor.
Have you developed any strong beliefs that other people say are untrue or unreasonable?

Well, I know it probably sounds a bit odd... but lately, I've gotten really convinced that some of the customers coming into the shop aren't actually there to buy anything. I think they're coming in just to check up on me, to see if I'm going to miss payments or if our business is failing. They just ask way too many specific questions about our new showroom. My husband keeps telling me they're just being friendly and making conversation, but... I don't know, it just feels like they have an ulterior motive to me.
Have there been any periods lasting a month or more when these experiences and communication difficulties completely went away?
No, they haven't gone away at all. It's just been pretty constant since it started. I haven't had any breaks from it for a month or anything like that.
Did these experiences begin after a head injury, seizure, stroke, or other problem affecting your brain?
No, nothing like that. I haven't hit my head or had a stroke or a seizure or... anything physically wrong with my brain. None of that happened before this all started.
Have these experiences and communication difficulties occurred during periods when you were not feeling unusually depressed or unusually elevated or irritable?

Yes, actually. There was a stretch before the depression really settled in. I was still feeling fine, really—I was still running my jewelry classes and keeping up with my gardening. But even then, for several weeks, I kept hearing those noises coming from the polishing room, and I was already worrying that the customers were watching the business. So, yes, those things were happening before my mood got so low.
